findings.title: Italian text replaces Lithuanian translation in loginTotpStep1
findings.body: The Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 now reads "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian. Lithuanian users will see an untranslated string. The text should be Lithuanian, or the key should be removed so it falls back to English.

findings.title: Italian text replaces Lithuanian translation in account totpStep1
findings.body: The Lithuanian account bundle's totpStep1 was replaced with the Italian sentence "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:". Users see the wrong language. It should be translated to Lithuanian.

findings.title: Traditional Chinese text in zh_CN bundle
findings.body: totpStep1 in the Simplified Chinese bundle now uses Traditional Chinese characters (在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一). It was copied from zh_TW and should be Simplified: 在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一。

findings.title: English file lookup is fragile and crashes the verifier
findings.body: The English counterpart path is derived with regexes: `_[a-zA-Z-_]*\.properties` is replaced with `_en.properties`. Files whose English counterpart does not exist (for example the admin-ui community bundles, or a bundle named without a locale suffix) throw a RuntimeException that aborts the whole build instead of reporting a message. The regex is also greedy over underscores in directory or file names. It should handle a missing English file gracefully.

findings.title: Properties file read as ISO-8859-1 for non-UTF-8 input
findings.body: PropertyResourceBundle(InputStream) decodes as UTF-8 and falls back to ISO-8859-1 on malformed input. The verifier relies on this for the theme files, which can silently change the compared text for some encodings. Reading with an explicit Reader would be more deterministic.

findings.title: Turkish error-invalid-multivalued-size still has trailing comma and old wording
findings.body:
The Turkish bundle still has the pre-existing broken format where every entry ends with a trailing comma and a leading space. The values therefore contain stray commas ("...
{0},"). The PR touches these lines but leaves the corruption in place, so the verifier may flag or mishandle them.
